thread:
Maya (marketing): Quick sync — we need a pocket brief (one-pager) for an enterprise launch slate. Core asks: security controls summary, SLA bullets (latency & uptime), and a short deploy-mode matrix (hosted / dedicated / private). This is for field handout + webinar slide takeaway. Can we do a sprint to get a draft by EOD Thu?

Raj (growth): +1. Target audience: CISO and platform engineering leads. Keep it <1 page, one column, with a 1-2 sentence hook and 3 quick value props: predictable latency, cost controls, private networking.

Lina (product): For SLAs — propose we call out: 
- 99.95% availability for Dedicated (commit tier)
- Best-effort for Hosted with standardized fallbacks
- Private comes with optional infra SLAs (negotiated)
Also add a tiny note about automatic fallback to compatible model variants during capacity events.

Omar (field): Field needs two CTAs: 1) Request a secure pilot (VPC/on-prem), 2) Get a cost/latency estimate for your workload. For inbound routing, leads who select "pilot" should route to AE@enterprise within 2 hours; "estimate" goes into Growth queue for an automated cost calc. We use HubSpot tag: "enterprise_brief_request".

Jules (designer): I can mock a compact layout — headline, 3 icons, and a tiny table for deploy modes. Want to use the blue security badge we used in the govcloud brief. Any copy constraints?

Ken (eng): Quick benchmark bullets to include (we should avoid exact promises but share median observed numbers):
- p50 generation latency: ~60ms per token (4k context) on Dedicated T4-like pool
- Throughput: ~2k tokens/sec per GPU (continuous batching)
- Typical token cost reduction with prefix caching: 20-35%
These are experimental but fine as "observed" figures with a small-print caveat.

Maya (marketing): Love that. Keep numbers as "observed medians during internal benchmarks". Jules — go ahead with a compact draft. Lina/Omar — I'll draft two short CTAs and a 2-sentence hook for the top. Raj — can you define routing rules for HubSpot?

Raj (growth): Routing plan: HubSpot form will have radio: "Secure pilot" / "Estimate" / "General inquiry". Map to workflows:
- Secure pilot -> assign to AE@enterprise + slack ping #sales-enterprise, tag: enterprise_brief_request, SLA: respond in 2 hrs
- Estimate -> Growth queue, run cost-estimate lambda (via webhook) + email with ballpark PDF within 24 hrs
- General -> Marketing nurture flow
I can prototype the form by tomorrow morning.

Omar (field): Also request a 1-slide benchmark insert for the webinar: 3 bullets (latency, throughput, cost delta) + a short note: "results vary by model and workload; contact us for a tailored test".

Jules (designer): Mock ETA: 18 hrs. Deliverables: 1) printable one-pager PDF (A4/letter) 2) webinar slide PNG 3) small hero image for email + 1 social card.

Ken (eng): One more ask: include a tiny "how it works" micro-diagram (3 boxes): Serving runtime -> Smart routing -> Caching & batching. I can give the short copy for each box.

Maya (marketing): Action list:
- Maya: write 2-sentence hook + 3 value props + CTA copy (EOD Thu)
- Jules: design mock (18 hrs)
- Lina: approve SLA phrasing + fallback blurb (tomorrow noon)
final_comment: Maya (marketing): If all good, we'll schedule a webinar mention in the next partner newsletter and push a launch post with the 3-line benchmark highlight. Keep the tone technical but concise.
